envelope.description: Name the ISSUE-anchored situation in the define-missing error

body.title: Name the ISSUE-anchored situation in the define-missing error
body.summary: In src/workflow/gates.ts readDefineArtifact, when the DEF is absent and an ISSUE root exists at the same hash, throw the same ArtifactMissingError class with a message that says the work item is an ISSUE-anchored bugfix with no Define or HLD, and does not tell the user to run define. Without an ISSUE root the message is unchanged. requireApprovedEpic still refuses the ISSUE.
acceptanceChecks: readDefineArtifact and requireApprovedEpic on an ISSUE-only hash throw ArtifactMissingError whose message names the ISSUE and omits the 'run define' advice
on a hash with neither root the original message is unchanged

tests.name: gates.test.ts: readDefineArtifact on an ISSUE-only hash names the ISSUE and does not advise running define
gates.test.ts: readDefineArtifact on a hash with neither root keeps the original message
